notes: Crash fix: the game could crash a few seconds after logging in when many new items had just been added (for example every weapon skin). The crash was inside UE4SS's object cache while the game loaded those items; Lantern Client now turns that cache off (UE4SS-settings.ini, original kept as UE4SS-settings.ini.lantern-bak). The game mod also no longer searches the game's objects in town or on the game's own thread. Close the game fully and start it again after updating.
